text:
amy (PM): Quick design check-in on the invite + roles panel mock: https://www.figma.com/file/unique. Three open questions: 1) SSO toggle scope (org header vs tenant settings), 2) visualizing role inheritance in the matrix, 3) fast audit access (global hotkey + inline anchors). Any immediate blockers? :eyes:

leo (Designer): Pushed two variants: header banner toggle (prominent) and compact header toggle (smaller, with help text). For inheritance I added a faint connector line and a tooltip that explains "inherited from org". Not sure about contrast on the connector.

soph (Frontend): header banner easier to implement but risks accidental flips. Compact toggle in a settings flyout is safer. Implementation note for inline anchors: use route param `/orgs/:id/audit?anchor=evt_…`. Can add a graceful fallback if audit index missing.

max (Eng): accessibility nit: connector lines are purely visual — need a text affordance for screen readers like "Role inherited from Org Admin" and aria-describedby on affected cells. Also recommend using aria-live to announce role assignment changes when done via keyboard.

tori (Support): customers repeatedly ask for a one-click path to audit entries. Please include a persistent Audit icon in header and Ctrl/Cmd+K command palette entry that searches audit events. KB will need screenshots.

leo (Designer): thinking: show inheritance as a small badge on the role chip (stacked dot) + hover reveals origin. That reduces visual clutter vs lines. Will mock both.

soph (Frontend): prefer a badge approach — less layout complexity. For badge clicks we can open a contextual popover linking to the specific audit event: `/orgs/:id/audit?anchor=evt_12345`. CSS note: avoid adding new DOM on hover to prevent reflow; toggle visibility with opacity only.

a11y-bot: Quick checklist: 1) SSO toggle must expose aria-checked and a short aria-label. 2) Inheritance badge needs accessible name (`aria-label="Inherited role: Billing Admin from Org X"`). 3) Ensure role changes are announced via aria-live polite region. 4) Audit Finder command must be reachable via keyboard and have proper focus trap.

max (Eng): also flag keyboard focus for the compact rows — visible focus ring on chips and badges. Current frames hide outlines. That will block keyboard nav.

amy (PM): copy tweaks: change "Invite team" -> "Invite people" (agreed) and SSO copy to "Enforce SSO sign-in" with helper "blocks non-SSO logins". Also, we should add a short confirmation modal when turning on SSO at org level.

tori (Support): confirmation modal is good — reduces accidental support tickets. I'll draft KB text and include notes about service tokens and automation breaks.

soph (Frontend): will prototype route param anchor and keyboard shortcut. Will post a small code snippet in PR: `router.push({ path: /orgs/${orgId}/audit, query: { anchor: evtId } })`.

leo (Designer): i'll update figma with badge variant + compact toggle and show the confirmation modal. Posting updated frames shortly.

max (Eng): i'll run a quick NVDA/VoiceOver pass on the updated frames once posted. Will call out any aria gaps.

a11y-bot: Reminder: run axe and include automated results in the PR description.

amy (PM): thanks — action items: leo update mocks with badge + confirm modal; soph spike anchor + cmd/k; max a11y walkthrough; tori KB draft. Reconvene Tue morning.
